patch_description: Replace the linear CZ chain with a full CZ ring (including 7→0 wrap) plus 4 cross-connections (0-4, 1-5, 2-6, 3-7) for long-range entanglement. Replace the post-entanglement RZ layer with RY, which directly converts entanglement-created phase correlations into amplitude differences measurable by Z-basis readout. This keeps the same parameter count (24 per block, 146 total) but significantly improves both the entanglement topology and the rotation structure.
